node.label: Decreased portal vein velocity
node.definition: A reduction in the velocity of portal venous flow, generally measured by Doppler ultrasound. Portal venous flow is normally towards the liver with peak systolic velocities in the range of 20-40 cm/s.

evidence.snippet: Cholestasis, progressive familial intrahepatic, 13: Decreased portal vein velocity (frequency 1/2) [PCS]
